theme: stale plate GC AGE MTIME STARTSI POP work bag

tests.name: positive_gc_trash
tests.cmd: aged tmp_*.plate + keep.live; MAX_AGE=3600 PREFIX=tmp_ SUFFIX=.plate
tests.note: stale=2 fresh=1 skip=1 moved=2; STARTSI matches TMP_OLD2; trash holds both

tests.name: work_pop_lifo
tests.note: n_moved=2; WORK.bag emptied; out markers touched

weaknesses.title: AGE/MTIME miss: AGE=0 and err_line=0 sticky under -s
weaknesses.detail: Missing path soft-fails OK=0 AGE=0 MTIME=0 — same AGE as a just-created file if OK ignored. last_err='mtime: missing' but err_line=0. Under -s without CLEAR_ERR, plate fails. Agents must always branch on OK after AGE.
weaknesses.repro: SYS AGE /no/such under -q -s → ok=false last_err=mtime: missing err_line=0

weaknesses.title: POP does not mutate bag — need LET bag = POP_REST
weaknesses.detail: Same class as PUSH: SYS POP bag leaves bag var stale; remaining fields only in POP_REST. Work loop must rebind every iteration.
weaknesses.repro: SYS POP bag without LET bag=POP_REST → infinite same last field if reusing bag

weaknesses.title: Cannot set historical mtime in-language (TOUCH only now)
weaknesses.detail: Tests and lease backdating need host touch -d. TOUCH only refreshes to wall clock. No SYS UTIME/CHTIME.
weaknesses.repro: Cannot create stale fixture without shell touch -d

weaknesses.title: LIST non-recursive — nested cache dirs invisible
weaknesses.detail: GC only sees top-level basenames under cache/. Nested plates need host find or multi-level LIST.

weaknesses.title: SYS STARTS (case-sensitive) weaker discoverability vs STARTSI
weaknesses.detail: search STARTS returns STARTSI example; case-sensitive STARTS/ENDS still work but catalog emphasis is I variants. TRIM still missing.
weaknesses.repro: search STARTS → STARTSI; search TRIM → empty

workarounds: After SYS AGE always IF OK==0 CLEAR_ERR CONTINUE before comparing age
LET bag = POP_REST after every POP
Use host touch -d for stale fixtures in tests
Flat cache layout or repeated LIST per subdir
STARTSI/ENDSI for extension/prefix filters without UPPER
language_gaps: Catalog TRIM; clarify STARTS vs STARTSI in search
